brief:
Palestine National University is introducing new academic specializations and rolling out institutional development plans, according to the Ma'an news agency. Dr. Fayez Abu Ameriya, the university's vice president for academic affairs, outlined the initiatives in a recent interview covering the institution's strategic direction and academic offerings.

The university is actively accepting registrations for its expanded program portfolio as it seeks to strengthen its educational capacity and institutional standing. The new specializations form part of broader efforts to enhance the quality and range of academic disciplines available to students at the Palestinian institution.
